findings.claim: Objective is final predicted target affinity (primary) with validity and strain secondary, under coordinate-only control. Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so no finding here can be read as a decoded terminal affinity effect.

Endpoint pointcloud effects are strongest and most consistent for short-range pair kernels: pair_kernel_1.5 (integrated z 0.562, q 1.5e-4, positive batch fraction 1.0), pair_kernel_2.5 (0.631, q 2.2e-5, 1.0), pair_kernel_3.5 (0.540, q 9.8e-5, 1.0), pair_kernel_5.0 (0.319, q 3.7e-3, 0.857), while pair_kernel_7.0 is negative (-0.485, q 1.5e-4, 0.0). These are diagnostic coordinate descriptors, not interaction energies.

Landmark occupancy3/softmin contrasts are mixed in sign across landmarks: landmark_00_occupancy3 positive (0.545, q 2.4e-4, 1.0) and landmark_00_softmin negative (-0.481, q 8.1e-4, 0.0); landmark_02_softmin positive (0.253, q 4.6e-3) with landmark_02_occupancy3/5 negative; landmark_06_softmin positive (0.294, q 6.8e-4, 1.0) with landmark_06_occupancy3/5 negative. No single landmark direction is uniformly favorable.

Shape contrasts are negative for shape_xx (-0.495, q 8.1e-4), shape_yy (-0.513, q 1.5e-5), shape_zz (-0.183, q 0.067) and shape_yz (-0.212, q 0.035), while shape_xz is positive (0.185, q 0.219, not significant). Shape_yy is the most consistent negative endpoint contrast.

Global centroid endpoint contrasts are weak and mostly non-significant: centroid_x -0.111 (q 0.257), centroid_y -0.243 (q 0.0136), centroid_z -0.061 (q 0.481). Centroid_y is the only nominally significant centroid component.

Joint rigid-motion residuals show the most consistent branch-adjusted correlations: joint_innovation_RMS_A (raw r -0.142, q 9.3e-5, same-sign batch fraction 1.0; adjusted r -0.150, q 2.8e-4, 0.929) and joint_internal_RMS_A (raw -0.130, q 1.5e-4, 1.0; adjusted -0.137, q 1.3e-5, 1.0), with joint_translation_RMS_A weaker (-0.067 raw, -0.076 adjusted).

Branch-adjusted pair-kernel correlations are positive for short kernels: pair_kernel_1.5 (raw 0.085, q 2.7e-2; adjusted 0.101, q 1.9e-2), pair_kernel_2.5 (raw 0.088, q 4.1e-2; adjusted 0.084, q 4.6e-2), pair_kernel_3.5 (raw 0.046, q 0.122; adjusted 0.033, q 0.147), and negative for pair_kernel_7.0 (raw -0.055, q 0.095; adjusted -0.050, q 0.129).

Success/failure increment rates are significant for landmark_00_softmin (-4.91, q 0.046), landmark_00_occupancy3 (+4.28, q 0.081), pair_kernel_2.5 (+3.96, q 0.208), pair_kernel_7.0 (-3.14, q 0.208), shape_xx (-3.70, q 0.095) and shape_yy (-3.85, q 0.161). These are recorded joint-head credit increments, not decoded terminal affinity.

Survival enrichment is positive for landmark_00_soft_mass (0.365, q 0.120), landmark_07_soft_mass (0.220, q 0.356), landmark_10_soft_mass (0.234, q 0.302) and landmark_18_local_czz (0.217, q 0.302), and negative for landmark_05_local_czz (-0.419, q 0.120) and landmark_09_local_czz (-0.390, q 0.120). Survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity.

Turnover residual rates are large and positive for many landmark local_cxx/cyy/czz fields (e.g. landmark_00_local_cxx +4.29, q 0.038; landmark_00_local_cyy +5.05, q 0.033; landmark_01_local_cyy +6.40, q 0.014; landmark_04_local_cxx +5.67, q 0.012; landmark_07_local_cyy +5.63, q 0.019; landmark_08_local_cxx +5.54, q 0.012; landmark_16_local_cyy +6.37, q 0.012; landmark_17_local_cxx +5.24, q 0.012; landmark_19_local_cxx +5.30, q 0.012). The turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.

Observed-node linear trends are non-extrapolating (extrapolation_allowed false) and show frequent sign changes and strong sign conflicts (e.g. landmark_00_local_dx first_rate_z -17.5, last_rate_z +8.1, 6 sign changes, 9 strong conflicts; landmark_07_local_dy first_rate_z -77.4, last_rate_z +7.3, 4 sign changes, 11 strong conflicts). No polynomial was accepted for any continuous feature.

Curve support selected 24 of the audited features under a strict rule (relative RMSE <= 0.35, quiet-node large-fit fraction <= 0.1, zero strong sign conflicts); all audited features have legendre_runtime_allowed false. Information audit reports compressed-choice excess fixed RMS 0.081 A (CI 0.070-0.092) and top4 teacher overlap 0.470 (CI 0.427-0.515). Joint diagnostics show selection-innovation associations with innovation_native_alignment (0.092, q 2.2e-9) and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment (0.226, q 2.2e-9), and a negative association with observed_child_score_gain (-0.036, q 1.8e-7).

hypotheses.claim: Short-range pair-kernel density (1.5-5.0 A) is the most consistently favorable endpoint coordinate contrast, while the 7.0 A kernel is consistently unfavorable; this pattern is stable across endpoint, branch-adjusted and increment views.

Landmark softmin and occupancy3/5 contrasts are landmark-specific in sign, so a single global landmark direction is unlikely to be uniformly favorable; any regional attention change would need to be landmark-selective.

Negative shape_xx/shape_yy contrasts (more compact transverse shape) are associated with favorable endpoint and increment contrasts, but shape descriptors are not interaction energies and this is a coordinate association only.

Lower joint innovation and internal RMS residuals are associated with favorable branch-adjusted contrasts, suggesting rigid-motion residual magnitude is a candidate diagnostic axis, though it is not a coordinate gradient or causal mechanism.

Large positive turnover residual rates on landmark local covariance fields may reflect score reclassification and extant-parent weighting rather than resampling, so they should not be interpreted as causal selection effects.

Frequent sign changes and strong sign conflicts in observed-node linear trends, together with no accepted polynomial and no runtime Legendre allowance, suggest that within-window temporal trends are not stable enough to support extrapolation beyond the observed support.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
Pair kernels, moments and turnover rates are diagnostic evidence only; the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters; no temperature edit is proposed or implied.
